```sql
SELECT home_name, away_name, home_score, away_score, 
       CASE WHEN home_score > away_score THEN home_name ELSE away_name END as winner
FROM games
WHERE season = 2023 AND tourney_round = 'National Championship';
```

```sql
SELECT efg_pct
FROM team_seasons
WHERE team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name = 'Saint Mary''s')
AND season = 2025;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) as overtime_games
FROM games
WHERE season = 2026 AND ot_periods > 0;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT team_id) 
FROM team_seasons 
WHERE season = 2026 AND wins >= 30;
```

```sql
SELECT conference, AVG(rating) as avg_rating
FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2026
GROUP BY conference
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT AVG(attendance) as avg_attendance
FROM games
WHERE season = 2024
  AND home_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name = 'Kentucky')
  AND neutral = 0
  AND attendance IS NOT NULL;
```

```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) as close_games
FROM games
WHERE season BETWEEN 2021 AND 2026
  AND season_type = 3
  AND ABS(margin) <= 3;
```

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT tg.opp_id, tg.opp_name
FROM team_games tg
WHERE tg.team_id = (SELECT team_id FROM teams WHERE name = 'Duke')
  AND tg.season = 2025
  AND tg.win = 0
ORDER BY tg.date;
```

```sql
FROM team_games tg
```

```sql
SELECT team_id, ppg
FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2023 AND team_id IN ('alabama', 'gonzaga')
ORDER BY ppg DESC;
```

```sql
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_games,
  SUM(CASE WHEN tg.team_id = 'duke' AND tg.win = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as duke_wins
FROM team_games tg
WHERE tg.season >= 2019 AND tg.season <= 2025
AND tg.team_id = 'duke'
AND tg.opp_id = 'unc'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_games,
  SUM(CASE WHEN tg.team_id = 'unc' AND tg.win = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as duke_wins
FROM team_games tg
WHERE tg.season >= 2019 AND tg.season <= 2025
AND tg.team_id = 'unc'
AND tg.opp_id = 'duke';
```

```sql
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_games,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (home_id = 'duke' AND away_id = 'unc' AND home_score > away_score) 
           OR (away_id = 'duke' AND home_id = 'unc' AND away_score > home_score) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as duke_wins
FROM games
WHERE season >= 2019 AND season <= 2025
AND ((home_id = 'duke' AND away_id = 'unc') OR (home_id = 'unc' AND away_id = 'duke'));
```

```sql
SELECT team_id, name, tempo, rating
FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2026
ORDER BY rating DESC
LIMIT 10
ORDER BY tempo ASC
LIMIT 1;
```


Actually, that won't work correctly. Let me use a subquery:

```sql
SELECT team_id, name, tempo, rating
FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2026 AND team_id IN (
  SELECT team_id FROM team_seasons 
  WHERE season = 2026 
  ORDER BY rating DESC 
  LIMIT 10
)
ORDER BY tempo ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT team_id, name, conf_wins
FROM team_seasons
WHERE season = 2026 AND conference = 'Big Ten'
ORDER BY conf_wins DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT 
  ts1.team_id,
  ts1.name,
  ts1.rating,
  ts2.team_id,
  ts2.name,
  ts2.rating,
  ABS(ts1.rating - ts2.rating) as rating_gap
FROM team_seasons ts1
JOIN team_seasons ts2 ON ts1.season = ts2.season
WHERE ts1.season = 2026
  AND ts1.team_id = 'michigan'
  AND ts2.team_id = 'michigan-state';
```

```sql

FROM games

```

```sql
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN win = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN win = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as losses
FROM team_games
WHERE team_id = 'CONN' AND date < '2024-01-01';
```

```sql

FROM games
WHERE season = 2023
  AND date LIKE '2022-12%'
  AND ot_periods > 0;
```

```sql

FROM team_games
WHERE team_id = 'duke' AND season = 2025
GROUP BY team_id
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
